### What a Public Liability Claim Covers

- **Slip and fall accidents** on wet floors in shops or supermarkets.
- **Injuries in parks, schools, or council properties** caused by poor maintenance.
- **Dog bites** or unsafe private property hazards.
- **Compensation** for medical bills, lost wages, and pain and suffering.[[1]](https://littleslawyers.com.au/melbourne/public-liability-lawyers/)[[2]](https://www.personalinjurylawyersperthwide.com.au/blog/types-of-claims-covered-in-public-liability/)[[3]](https://www.workerscompensationlawyersperthwa.com.au/workers-compensation-lawyers-balcatta/)

### Key Time Limits in Western Australia

- **Three-year limit** : Under the *Limitation Act 2005* , you generally have three years from the date of the injury to file a personal injury claim in WA. Acting quickly helps secure witness statements and camera footage before it disappears.[[1]](https://www.gotocourt.com.au/personal-injury/wa/negligence)[[2]](https://littleslawyers.com.au/melbourne/public-liability-lawyers/)
